column1: 5.5.4.2.25.3 Map Display. ‘Map Display’ in ‘Graphics Window’ shall present the
instantaneous tactical picture of intercepted emitters as on overlay on ‘Geo Tiff’ based to
user. The same colour code and identification scheme followed in ‘Tactical Display’ shall
be followed here in ‘Map Display’ for representing track data. Map specific features, as
mentioned below, shall be provided on this display.
